meta.description: Two Italian locations: Westboro at 275 Richmond Road, Kanata at 499 Terry Fox Drive.

callbar.line: Kanata: reservations are not required but are recommended. Call (613) 592-0225 — we do not book tables on this preview.
callbar.short: Kanata tables by phone — not here.
callbar.westboro: Westboro tables are on OpenTable or (613) 722-6772 — this preview does not take a table.
callbar.westboroShort: Westboro: OpenTable — we don’t book here.
callbar.family: Two locations. Westboro books on OpenTable. Kanata tables by phone: (613) 592-0225.
callbar.familyShort: Two locations — Westboro OpenTable · Kanata phone.

home.title: Vino, pasta, pizza.
home.lead: A neighbourhood Italian location on Terry Fox Drive. Their board, their photos, their phone.
home.heroAlt: The pizza oven wall at Fratelli Kanata.
home.hoursLead: As printed on fratellikanata.ca. Hours are subject to change — please call to inquire.
home.reserveLead: Reservations are not required but are recommended. Call (613) 592-0225. Parties of 10 or more: email events@fratelli-kanata.ca. This preview does not take a table.
home.menuLead: Antipasti, pasta, wood-fired pizza, meat and pesce. We show their published board. Prices may change.
home.photosLead: Photographs they publish on the live site.
home.eventsLead: Upstairs seats up to 32 for seated lunches and dinners. Email the event team — we do not take the booking here.
home.roomAlt: The dining room and upstairs loft at Fratelli Kanata.

menu.title: Menu
menu.lead: Copied from the dine-in board they publish on fratellikanata.ca. Tax extra. Prices may change. Please make your server aware of any allergies — as they print.
menu.asOf: Snapshot of their live board, 23 August 2026.
menu.boardCaption: Their published board. The lists below are a transcription of that image, not a second menu.
menu.allergens: Please make your server aware of any allergies.

hours.title: Hours
hours.lead: Dine-in hours as printed on their home page. Takeout uses a different window — see Takeout.
hours.change: Hours are subject to change, please call to inquire.
hours.book: Reservations are not required but are recommended. Call (613) 592-0225.
hours.parties: Parties of 10 or more: email events@fratelli-kanata.ca.
hours.westboro: fratelli.ca is Fratelli Westboro at 275 Richmond Road, with OpenTable. That is not this location.

takeout.title: Takeout
takeout.lead: We only accept orders via phone, (613) 592-0225. If the line is busy, try again. We do not invent an online cart.
takeout.hoursLead: Printed on their takeout page — not the same as dine-in.
takeout.openHours: They also write that takeout is available during open hours, then print this window.
takeout.beer: Beer and wine are also available for takeout.
takeout.pickup: Standard pickup is 15–20 minutes for most orders; some take longer. Orders can be pre-ordered up to an hour prior to pickup.
takeout.pay: They print cash, Interact, credit cards including American Express, and payment over the phone if you ask when ordering.
takeout.deadLink: Their takeout page still points at kanata.fratelli.ca /menu2020. That path 404s, and kanata.fratelli.ca now redirects to Fratelli Westboro. We do not send you there for this kitchen.
takeout.covid: That takeout page still carries 2020 pickup-area notes. We keep the phone-order rule; we do not treat mask language as current house policy.

events.title: Events
events.lead: Looking to host a business lunch or dinner, a wedding shower or rehearsal dinner? They have an exclusive hosting space in the upstairs loft.
events.seats: The loft seats up to 32 people for seated lunches and dinners.
events.menus: They offer a variety of set menus and specialty menu items for groups. We do not invent those menus.
events.email: Email the event team at events@fratelli-kanata.ca.
events.gratuity: Groups of 8 or more are subject to an automatic gratuity of 20%.
events.cake: Outside desserts will be subject to a plating fee reflective of the group’s size. They do not print a dollar amount — neither do we.

about.title: About
about.glebe: Established in 1996 in the Glebe, their vision was a neighbourhood restaurant with good Italian food, good wine, and friendly service in an unpretentious atmosphere. Robert and mother Louisa ran the kitchen; Richard and father Pasquale worked the dining room.
about.kanata: They continue as fratelli. Kanata prints the family-owned location on Terry Fox Drive. Westboro prints “now in Westboro.”
about.roberto: They also point to Roberto Pizza in Little Italy. That is a different site. We link it; we do not rebuild it as this location.
about.notWestboro: Kanata is 499 Terry Fox Drive. Westboro is 275 Richmond Road.
about.twoLocations: fratelli.ca is Westboro (OpenTable, 613-722-6772). fratellikanata.ca is Kanata (phone tables, 613-592-0225). We do not mix the locations.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Call the restaurant. Email is for events and parties of 10 or more — not a booking form.
contact.noForm: There is no reservation form on their live site. There is none here.

family.title: Fratelli.
family.lead: Brothers. Two kitchens. Kanata on Terry Fox Drive. Westboro on Richmond Road. Each location keeps its own phone, hours, and booking door.
family.locationsLead: We do not mix the two live sites. Kanata has no OpenTable. Westboro books on OpenTable.
family.kanataReserve: Tables by phone. Not required, recommended.
family.westboroReserve: Tables on OpenTable, or call the Westboro line.

westboro.title: Westboro.
westboro.lead: fratelli.ca. Enoteca and wood-fired pizza at 275 Richmond Road. Since 1996, now in Westboro — as they write it.
westboro.heroAlt: The Fratelli storefront on Richmond Road in Westboro.
westboro.contactLead: Westboro prints (613) 722-6772 and juliana@fratelli.ca. That is not the Kanata line.
westboro.parties: Private parties go through their live parties page. We do not take the booking here.
westboro.specialsLead: Copied from fratelli.ca. Specials change. Half-price wine Monday is on their drinks page.
westboro.eventsNote: Their events page currently lists National Pasta Day (Saturday October 17th) and National Cappuccino Day (Sunday November 8th), as printed.
westboro.notKanata: This is not 499 Terry Fox Drive. Kanata has its own site, phone, and takeout hours.
westboro.noForm: This preview does not take a table. Westboro reservations stay on OpenTable.

footer.line: Two locations. Westboro is fratelli.ca. Kanata is fratellikanata.ca. Their live sites stay until they switch.
footer.copy: Preview of the two Fratelli locations. Live sites stay until they say otherwise. French is a courtesy toggle — their sites are English.
